svg.aria-label: Six scales of the CDK9 site, from the whole complex down to the quantum region, with heavy-atom counts and the pipeline stage that works at each scale
svg.title: What each stage actually holds
svg.text: Every stage works on a different object. Same camera, same centre, same structure — only the radius changes. CDK9 with flavopiridol, 3BLR.
Bright is kept, dim is discarded. Counts are heavy atoms, measured, not estimated.
Crop radius is not a setting to be guessed. Between 4 and 15 Å the quantum cost moves by more than two orders of magnitude, and nobody has told us where the accuracy stops improving.
That is why s2.crop_radius_A is swept rather than chosen. See docs/04-experiments/hpo-microtopic.md.

Cost is a cubic scaling on atom count, relative to the 4 Å region. Indicative, not a benchmark — day 1 replaces it with wall-clock. Hydrogens are absent at this resolution and roughly double every count.
No cyclin T1 residue falls inside 15 Å — the first one appears at 18. Every radius we are considering drops the cyclin, and the cyclin is what holds the αC helix in place.
